_comment: Mode configuration. Values marked PROPOSAL are prototype defaults (design/decision-register.md), not confirmed rules. CONFIRMED values come from the user.
rewards_note: CONFIRMED C-02: each player picks 4 rewards after every game, any combination of add/remove/change basic type.
reward_add_offer_note: PROPOSAL: an add-card reward offers 3 random cards; pick one.
first_player_rule: CONFIRMED C-01: loser of the previous game chooses who goes first. PROPOSAL P-01: game 1 coin flip.
basic_change_note: F06-04 (user): the Change basic units reward turns EVERY basic unit in the deck into the chosen Type and Race, for one pick.

draft._note: PROPOSAL P-03: category draft, pick 1 of `offer` each time. F06-05: each player orders the categories before drafting. F06-06: no basic-unit category; each player chooses a basic unit by Type and Race and gets `basic_copies` copies.

fatigue_note: CONFIRMED C-04: each draw that cannot be made (Draw and Spent empty) costs this much HP. Default value 2 is a proposal.
